description.value: The BC Liquor Store Yaletown branch is a provincial government-operated retail outlet selling wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders. It is part of the 198-store BCLIQUOR chain run by the BC Liquor Distribution Branch. A touring cyclist seeking food, water, or rest would find no food-service offerings here.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (7 spaces) at 87m; stands (3 spaces) at 98m; stands (7 spaces) at 98m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: This is a BC government-run retail liquor store (shop=alcohol) in Yaletown, Vancouver. The website confirms it is a standard BCLIQUOR retail outlet selling wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders — no food service, no dining, no cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags. None of the required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) or optional amenities are evidenced by either the website content or OSM tags, making this an unsuitable WWC Food & Drink listing.
concerns: Categorized as Food & Drink via shop=alcohol, but this is a pure retail alcohol outlet with no food or beverage service for cyclists.
Store-specific phone number (+1-604-664-0118) is not confirmed on the website; only head-office and customer-service numbers appear in website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a retail liquor store with no food service, no cyclist amenities, and no evidence of any WWC-relevant offerings. It does not serve the needs of touring cyclists and does not belong in the cycling tourism directory.
